response.overview: Mahima (2025) is a Kannada-language supernatural thriller set entirely in Canada. Mahima, a lively Kannadiga vlogger living in Toronto, comes from a wealthy family but was raised by her uncle and aunt. During a late-night trip to Niagara Falls with her niece Saanvi, she becomes involved in a hit-and-run and flees the scene. Consumed by guilt, Mahima soon finds herself haunted by a vengeful spirit, as mysterious deaths begin to strike her family. When Detective Arya investigates the disturbing events, a chilling mystery unfolds, forcing Mahima to confront the truth behind the haunting.
response.title: Mahima
